description: As an operations manager, I want to see real-time flight status updates so that I can monitor fleet operations.

acs.text: Flight status refreshes every 30 seconds without page reload.
Status color coding: green (on time), yellow (delayed), red (cancelled).
Clicking a flight row opens the detail panel with gate, ETA, and crew info.

comments.author: PM
comments.body: This story depends on TEST-INT-B for the crew API integration. Do not start TC gen until B is parsed.
